title: NBI invites Dutertes, Velasco to clear air on cash delivery allegations

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation has issued invitations to Vice President Sara Duterte, her brother Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte, and former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco as it continues its fact-finding investigation into alleged deliveries of money in suitcases.
